# AGUS Workspace Notes

- Frontend stack: React, TypeScript, Vite, lucide-react, and Recharts.
- Keep the dashboard focused on green building and construction workflows.
- Treat all included measurements and project records as illustrative demo data.
- Label AGUS scoring as internal assessment; never present it as official BGH or GBCI certification.
- Keep standards configurable and direct users to official, current source documents for regulatory requirements.
